head: Dash cam app for iPhone: ClaireCam records the road for free
dek: ClaireCam turns an iPhone into a dash cam: the free version records the road in HD, keeps recording in picture-in-picture while you use a navigation app, and overwrites the oldest clips when storage fills. Claire Sense Inc. released version 1.1.33 on 15 November.
details: Free features also include 10 scored trips, a speed screensaver for OLED screens and a gallery to trim, merge and share clips. ClaireCam Pro, with a 14-day free trial, adds road and cabin recording at once, up to 30 frames a second, unlimited trips with audio coaching, live trip sharing in a browser, speed and camera alerts and route hazard warnings. The listing doesn't give Pro's price. It needs iOS 17 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later); free, Pro with a 14-day trial
means: If you want dash cam footage without buying a dash cam, a phone in a mount can record your drives for free.
todo: Try the free version on a short drive first, and check the Pro price before the 14-day trial ends.
thumb_words: CLAIRECAM: IPHONE AS A DASH CAM
